title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (III)

articles.content_en: Article 1. A person who signs the articles of association for the purpose of establishing a company, subscribes to capital contributions or shares in the company, and performs the duties of establishing the company shall be identified as a promoter of the company, including shareholders at the time of establishment of a limited liability company.

Article 2. Where a promoter, for the purpose of establishing a company, signs a contract with an external party in its own name, and the other party to the contract requests that the promoter bear contractual liability, the People's Court shall support such request; after the company is established, if the other party to the contract requests that the company bear contractual liability, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 3. Where a promoter signs a contract with an external party in the name of the company being established, and after the company is established, the other party to the contract requests that the company bear contractual liability, the People's Court shall support such request.
After the company is established, if there is evidence proving that the promoter used the name of the company being established to sign a contract with the other party for its own benefit, and the company claims on this ground that it shall not bear contractual liability, the People's Court shall support such claim, unless the other party is bona fide.

Article 4. Where a company is not established for any reason, and a creditor requests all or some of the promoters to bear joint and several liability for repayment of the expenses and debts incurred from the acts of establishing the company, the People's Court shall support such request.
After some promoters bear liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, if they request other promoters to share the liability, the People's Court shall order the other promoters to share the liability in accordance with the agreed liability-sharing ratio; if no liability-sharing ratio is agreed upon, share the liability in accordance with the agreed capital contribution ratio; if no capital contribution ratio is agreed upon, share the liability in equal shares.
Where the company is not established due to the fault of some promoters, and other promoters claim that the former shall bear the expenses and debts incurred from the acts of establishment, the People's Court shall, based on the circumstances of fault, determine the scope of liability of the party at fault.

Article 5. Where a promoter causes damage to another person in the course of performing the duties of establishing the company, and after the company is established, the victim requests the company to bear tort compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request; where the company is not established, and the victim requests all promoters to bear joint and several compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request.
After the company or a promoter without fault bears compensation liability, it may seek recourse against the promoter at fault.

Article 6. Where a subscriber of shares of a joint stock limited company fails to pay the share subscription price within the prescribed time limit, and after the promoters of the company call for payment, the subscriber still fails to pay within a reasonable period, and the promoters raise funds separately for such shares, the People's Court shall determine that such fund-raising act is valid. Where the subscriber's delayed payment of the share subscription price causes losses to the company, and the company requests the subscriber to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 7. Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with property over which it does not have the right of disposal, and the parties dispute the validity of the capital contribution act, the People's Court may determine the matter by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code.
Where equity is obtained after making a capital contribution with monetary funds derived from illegal and criminal acts such as embezzlement, bribery, misappropriation, or appropriation, when investigating and punishing such illegal and criminal acts, the equity shall be disposed of by means of auction or sale.

Article 8. Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with the right to the use of allocated land, or with the right to the use of land on which a rights burden is imposed, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company claim that the capital contributor has failed to perform its capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall order the party to complete the land change procedures or remove the rights burden within a specified reasonable period; if the party fails to complete or remove within the time limit, the People's Court shall determine that the capital contributor has not fully performed its capital contribution obligation according to law.

Article 9. Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with non-monetary property without conducting valuation in accordance with law, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company request that it be determined that the capital contributor has failed to perform its capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall entrust a legally qualified appraisal institution to appraise and value the property. Where the value determined by appraisal is significantly lower than the value fixed in the company's articles of association, the People's Court shall determine that the capital contributor has not fully performed its capital contribution obligation according to law.

Article 10. Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with property such as a house, land-use right, or intellectual property requiring registration of ownership, and the property has been delivered to the company for use but the ownership change procedures have not been completed, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company claim that the capital contributor has failed to perform its capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall order the party to complete the ownership change procedures within a specified reasonable period; if the ownership change procedures are completed within the said period, the People's Court shall determine that the capital contributor has performed its capital contribution obligation; if the capital contributor claims to enjoy the corresponding shareholder's rights from the time it actually delivered the property to the company for use, the People's Court shall support such claim.
Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with the property specified in the preceding paragraph, and the ownership change procedures have been completed but the property has not been delivered to the company for use, and the company or other shareholders claim that the capital contributor shall deliver the property to the company and shall not enjoy the corresponding shareholder's rights before actual delivery, the People's Court shall support such claim.

Article 13. Where a shareholder fails to perform or fails to fully perform its capital contribution obligation, and the company or other shareholders request that it fully perform its capital contribution obligation to the company according to law, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where a creditor of the company requests a shareholder who has failed to perform or failed to fully perform its capital contribution obligation to bear supplementary compensation liability within the scope of the unpaid capital and its interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be paid off, the People's Court shall support such request; where the shareholder who has failed to perform or failed to fully perform its capital contribution obligation has already borne the above liability, and other creditors make the same request, the People's Court shall not support it.
Where a shareholder fails to perform or fails to fully perform its capital contribution obligation at the time of the company's establishment, and the plaintiff bringing an action in accordance with the first or second paragraph of this Article requests that the promoters of the company bear joint and several liability with the defendant shareholder, the People's Court shall support such request; after the promoters of the company bear liability, they may seek recourse against the defendant shareholder.
Where a shareholder fails to perform or fails to fully perform its capital contribution obligation at the time of a capital increase of the company, and the plaintiff bringing an action in accordance with the first or second paragraph of this Article requests that directors and senior officers who have failed to perform the obligations set forth in Article 147, paragraph 1 of the Company Law, thereby leaving the capital contribution unpaid, bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall support such request; after the directors and senior officers bear liability, they may seek recourse against the defendant shareholder.

Article 14. Where a shareholder withdraws its capital contribution, and the company or other shareholders request that it return the capital contribution and its interest to the company, and that other shareholders, directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who assisted in the withdrawal bear joint and several liability for this, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where a creditor of the company requests a shareholder who withdrew its capital contribution to bear supplementary compensation liability within the scope of the withdrawn capital and its interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be paid off, and that other shareholders, directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who assisted in the withdrawal bear joint and several liability for this, the People's Court shall support such request; where the shareholder who withdrew its capital contribution has already borne the above liability, and other creditors make the same request, the People's Court shall not support it.

Article 15. Where a capital contributor makes a capital contribution with non-monetary property that meets the statutory conditions, and the contributed property depreciates due to market changes or other objective factors, if the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company request that the capital contributor bear the liability to make up the capital contribution, the People's Court shall not support such request. However, unless the parties have otherwise agreed.

Article 16. Where a shareholder fails to perform or fails to fully perform its capital contribution obligation or withdraws its capital contribution, and the company makes corresponding reasonable restrictions on its shareholder's rights such as the right to claim profit distribution, the preemptive right to subscribe for new shares, and the right to claim distribution of remaining property in accordance with the company's articles of association or a resolution of the shareholders' meeting, if such shareholder requests that the restrictions be determined invalid, the People's Court shall not support the request.

Article 17. Where a shareholder of a limited liability company fails to perform its capital contribution obligation or withdraws all of its capital contribution, and after the company calls for payment or return, the shareholder still fails to pay or return the capital contribution within a reasonable period, and the company removes the shareholder's qualification by a resolution of the shareholders' meeting, if the shareholder requests confirmation that the removal is invalid, the People's Court shall not support the request.
In the circumstances specified in the preceding paragraph, when making a judgment, the People's Court shall clarify that the company shall promptly go through the statutory procedures for capital reduction, or other shareholders or third parties shall pay the corresponding capital contribution. Before the statutory procedures for capital reduction are completed or other shareholders or third parties pay the corresponding capital contribution, if a creditor of the company requests the relevant parties to bear corresponding liability in accordance with Article 13 or Article 14 of these Provisions, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 18. Where a shareholder of a limited liability company transfers its equity without performing or fully performing its capital contribution obligation, and the transferee knew or should have known of this, if the company requests that the shareholder perform its capital contribution obligation and that the transferee bear joint and several liability for this, the People's Court shall support such request; where a creditor of the company brings an action against such shareholder in accordance with Article 13, paragraph 2 of these Provisions and simultaneously requests that the aforementioned transferee bear joint and several liability for this, the People's Court shall support such request.
After the transferee bears liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, if it seeks recourse against the shareholder who failed to perform or failed to fully perform its capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall support such request. However, unless the parties have otherwise agreed.

Article 19. Where a shareholder of a company fails to perform or fails to fully perform its capital contribution obligation or withdraws its capital contribution, and the company or other shareholders request that it fully perform its capital contribution obligation to the company or return the capital contribution, if the defendant shareholder defends on the ground of limitation of action, the People's Court shall not support such defense.
Where the claim of a creditor of the company has not exceeded the limitation of action period, and the creditor requests the shareholder who failed to perform or failed to fully perform its capital contribution obligation or withdrew its capital contribution to bear compensation liability in accordance with Article 13, paragraph 2 and Article 14, paragraph 2 of these Provisions, if the defendant shareholder defends on the ground that the capital contribution obligation or the obligation to return capital contribution has exceeded the limitation of action period, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 20. Where the parties dispute whether the capital contribution obligation has been performed, if the plaintiff provides evidence that gives rise to reasonable doubt as to whether the shareholder has performed its capital contribution obligation, the defendant shareholder shall bear the burden of adducing evidence that it has performed its capital contribution obligation.

Article 21. Where a party brings a prosecution before the People's Court requesting confirmation of its shareholder qualification, it shall name the company as the defendant, and persons having an interest in the equity disputed in the case shall participate in the proceedings as third parties.

Article 23. After a party performs its capital contribution obligation according to law or acquires equity by succession according to law, if the company fails, in accordance with Articles 31 and 32 of the Company Law, to issue a capital contribution certificate, record the party in the register of shareholders, and complete registration with the company registration authority, and the party requests the company to perform the above obligations, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 24. Where an actual contributor and a nominal contributor of a limited liability company enter into a contract stipulating that the actual contributor shall make the capital contribution and enjoy the investment rights and interests, with the nominal contributor acting as the nominal shareholder, and the actual contributor and the nominal shareholder dispute the validity of the contract, if there are no circumstances of invalidity provided by law, the People's Court shall determine that the contract is valid.
Where the actual contributor and the nominal shareholder specified in the preceding paragraph dispute the ownership of investment rights and interests, and the actual contributor claims rights against the nominal shareholder on the ground that it has actually performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall support such claim. Where the nominal shareholder denies the rights of the actual contributor on the ground of the records in the company's register of shareholders or the registration with the company registration authority, the People's Court shall not support such denial.
Where the actual contributor, without the consent of more than half of the other shareholders of the company, requests the company to change the shareholders, issue a capital contribution certificate, record the actual contributor in the register of shareholders, record it in the company's articles of association, and complete registration with the company registration authority, the People's Court shall not support such request.

Article 25. Where a nominal shareholder transfers, pledges, or otherwise disposes of the equity registered in its name, and the actual contributor, on the ground that it enjoys actual rights in the equity, requests that the act of disposing of the equity be determined invalid, the People's Court may handle the matter by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code.
Where the nominal shareholder's disposal of the equity causes losses to the actual contributor, and the actual contributor requests the nominal shareholder to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 26. Where a creditor of the company, on the ground that the shareholder registered with the company registration authority has failed to perform its capital contribution obligation, requests that the shareholder bear supplementary compensation liability within the scope of the unpaid capital and its interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be paid off, and the shareholder defends on the ground that it is only a nominal shareholder rather than the actual contributor, the People's Court shall not support such defense.
After the nominal shareholder bears compensation liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, if it seeks recourse against the actual contributor, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 27. Where, after the transfer of equity, the change of registration has not yet been handled with the company registration authority, and the former shareholder transfers, pledges, or otherwise disposes of the equity still registered in its name, and the transferee shareholder, on the ground that it enjoys actual rights in the equity, requests that the act of disposing of the equity be determined invalid, the People's Court may handle the matter by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code.
Where the former shareholder's disposal of the equity causes losses to the transferee shareholder, and the transferee shareholder requests that the former shareholder bear compensation liability and that directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who are at fault for failing to timely handle the change of registration bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall support such request; where the transferee shareholder is also at fault for failing to timely handle the change of registration, the liability of the above-mentioned directors, senior officers, or actual controllers may be appropriately mitigated.

Article 28. Where a person makes a capital contribution by falsely using another person's name and registers that other person as a shareholder with the company registration authority, the person who effected the false registration shall bear corresponding liability; where the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company, on the ground that the capital contribution obligation has not been performed, request that the person falsely registered as a shareholder bear the liability to make up the capital contribution or bear compensation liability for the part of the company's debts that cannot be paid off, the People's Court shall not support such request.
